customManagers.description: The node24 the release job's tests load the addon with (tests/addon-compat-test.sh): a Mavergreen/nodejs-24 release tag, bare. CI-only, so a bump changes no shipped byte and publishes nothing. The versioning regex reads -mavericks.N as the build number; Renovate's default would coerce it away and never propose a -mavericks.N bump.
